propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture invokes git fetch with capture_output=True and check=True, causing CalledProcessError to report only exit status 128 and discard git's stderr explaining the actual cause
git fetch, archive, and ls-tree calls in the fixture have identical problematic shape: subprocess.run with captured output and immediate check, making failures undiagnostic
git fetch origin tickets is a single un-retried network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, so any transient network blip causes hard ERROR and drops test coverage
diagnostic fix requires new run_git() helper that captures output, checks explicitly, and raises RuntimeError with joined command, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr
bounded retry policy with backoff must apply to fetch-only with retry-then-FAIL semantics: genuine misconfiguration still reds the lane rather than silently dropping coverage
